paragraphs.text: Andra is a young, beautiful, well-spoken, and friendly Bane Alley broker and member of House Dimir , on the plane of Ravnica . She seems to cobble together a different outfit every day out of spare parts, but it's always somehow fashionable, and never overly modest.

Andra had a stall set up in Bane Alley, where she brokered deals for items of dubious origin. One of her setups was a fine, polished dagger. She didn’t know whether the knife was a murder weapon, stolen goods, or whatever else, and she didn’t want to. All she knew was that House Dimir wanted it sold to someone in particular, and they didn’t want any link between its new owners and her.

One of her favorite tricks was to sell someone an illicit item, and then arrange for it to be stolen by the real buyers. It broke the trail that led to her, and on top of that, she’d gotten paid twice for the same goods. Usually, the courier didn’t fare well in the bargain.

So when Bartek showed up with the gift of a pewter ornament for her, Andra knew he would be the perfect target. He bought the dagger off her for five zinos, believing she had an actual romantic interest in him, but she had arranged for him to receive a mugging the following day. Just this one, though, she’d asked the buyer to leave the kid alive.

When Bartek showed up the next day, she was genuinely relieved to see his face, even banged up as it was, but even more so satisfied that the dagger had indeed been taken with Bartek none the wiser of who had mugged him or why. She noted down her earnings, glancing at the pewter ornament Bartek had given her. The total earnings for the setup were 25 zinos, 20 from the initial proffering of the dagger, and five from Bartek's purchase. The gift he had given, she noted down as having negligible value.
